shots.intent: 在搜索列表里一眼给出整条长裤的廓形、腰头与裤脚形态，承担白底主图位
用一整屏黑条带加信号黄压角把第一利益点压进一秒法则，承接主图后的主张位

shots.intent: 把洗后腰头松垮、抽绳滑脱、裤脚外翻走形这些真实穿着摩擦放大成一眼可见的双格对照
用同机位侧身双格把一裤两穿的核心卖点变成可比对的视觉差异，替代任何数字承诺

shots.intent: 让买家把自己代入日常出行与轻运动的穿着状态，同时保持无人脸的合规裁切
用面料肌理微距替代任何成分与克重表述，靠可见织构建立品质感

shots.intent: 把可选配色一次性摊开让买家完成选择，色名一律走占位槽不写死

shots.intent: 用留空的量位线、指标条与规格网格回答选码疑问，同时不搬运任何实测数值

shots.intent: 用三处可见做工与留空的检验位替代任何资质与检测承诺，把风险感降下来
shots.textZone: 三格各一条短标签位＋底部一枚刻意留空的外框印章位

shots.intent: 收口把整套灰白黑黄的语言收敛成一个明确的行动位，不承诺任何真实优惠

style.backgroundSystem: one flat field per screen and never a staged space: cool paper-white #F7F7F9 seamless sweep for the packshot, the pain-point panels, the lifestyle sweep, the variant rail and the craft panels, cement-grey #D9D9DE for the cover hero, the two-wear comparison, the macro board, the spec card field and the close band; ink-black #15151A only ever as solid bars, index chips, caption tabs and table header rows; no scenery, no architecture, no gradient sky
style.direction: monochrome editorial streetwear menswear lookbook with one signal-yellow accent
style.iconSystem: flat rectilinear components only: solid ink-black numbered index chips with reversed italic numerals, thin outline empty image windows, L-shaped signal-yellow corner brackets, dashed square brackets around short labels and circled downward chevron markers, all drawn in #15151A or #F2C230; no round medallion icons, no filled badges, no shields, no seals, no award or certification marks, no raw-material pictograms
style.lightingSystem: neutral even studio light around 5000K, broad front key with a fill card on the shadow side, one clean soft contact shadow under every hem, one harder side light used only on the macro screen to read the knit relief, no harsh speculars, no coloured rim light
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent monochrome editorial streetwear menswear lookbook system across the entire image set; fixed palette of cool paper-white field #F7F7F9, cement-grey secondary field #D9D9DE, ink-black solid bars and table headers #15151A and one signal-yellow accent #F2C230; neutral even studio light around 5000K with a broad front key, a soft fill card and one clean contact shadow; one condensed grotesque family for every rendered line with letterspaced uppercase micro labels only, no serif, no script, no retro lettering; graphic components limited to solid ink-black index chips with reversed italic numerals, thin outline empty image windows, hairline and dashed rules, L-shaped signal-yellow corner brackets and circled downward chevrons; garment scale, waistband line and hem line kept identical across all screens; no round medallion icons, no spherical props, no tiered stage or plinth, no raw-material still life, no gradient sky, no scenic architecture, no colour palette changes, no mixed fonts, no invented numbers.
noDrift: no colour palette changes beyond #F7F7F9, #D9D9DE, #15151A and #F2C230
no mixed fonts and no serif, script or retro lettering
no spherical props, no tiered stage or plinth, no round medallion icons
no scenic architecture, no gradient sky, no coloured rim light
no invented numbers, percentages, sizes, test data, prices or badges
style.presentationRules: garment scale, waistband line and hem line kept identical across screens; invisible ghost form for worn-length views, flat lay from above for full-spread views, slim rail for the variant screen; any body reference stays a generic adult framed from the neck down with no face inside the crop; no chest, thigh or leg print artwork is ever rendered
style.surfaceSystem: matte paper-white seamless counter board #F7F7F9 for flat lay, matte cement-grey insert board #D9D9DE for macro and spec screens, one strip of signal-yellow #F2C230 floor tape as the only surface marking; no concrete, no wood, no stone, no fabric drape used as a surface
style.typography: one condensed grotesque family for every rendered line; one bold two-line reversed-white display headline inside a solid ink-black #15151A bar, one letterspaced uppercase micro kicker in #F2C230, hairline and dashed rules as the label system, headline 26-40pt, label 12-16pt; every rendered Chinese string comes from a selling_point or callout placeholder slot and never from source copy
